embed_text:
Q: Who can participate in Hacker House Goa?
A: Anyone with a passion for building! Whether you're a developer, designer, product manager, or just someone with great ideas - you're welcome here. Teams of 1-3 people are encouraged, but solo participants are also accepted.
context_text:

title: Who can participate in Hacker House Goa?

embed_text:
Q: How does the selection process work in Hacker House Goa?
A: - First, your team has to attend the shortlisting tasks - Top teams from shortlisting tasks are waitlisted - Best teams from the Waitlisted groups are selected for attending Hacker House Goa in-person.

embed_text:
Q: What should I bring to the event?
A: Bring your laptop, charger, any hardware you might need for your project, and your creative energy. We'll provide workspace, power outlets, WiFi, meals, and caffeine to keep you going.

Q: Is there a registration fee?
A: No! Participation in Hacker House Goa is completely free. We'll provide accommodation, meals, and all amenities during the 4-day event. You just need to get yourself to Goa!
